Historical Titan prefix-versus-bulk numerical blocker unresolved
Current host process/GPU reconciliation and contained watchdog path not qualified
dag: Immutable job request hash includes payload, epoch and existing dependencies; only succeeded dependencies permit READY.

host_wide_state.production_requirement: Every CRS worktree and coordinator shares the exact same local host database; per-worktree databases do not satisfy host-wide admission.
host_wide_state.ownership: owner, expiry, heartbeat and persistent strictly increasing fencing token
host_wide_state.stale_rule: Stale lease journals active jobs OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconcile every job and current process/GPU evidence before takeover. Expiry never permits an automatic duplicate dispatch.
host_wide_state.containment_limit: SQLite state and caller validation are cooperative contracts. A real worker must check fencing at every admitted operation and use qualified OS process containment. No OS isolation or hard kill/VRAM enforcement is provided by this module.

budgets.unknown_costs: Charge full reserved ceiling; active unknown reservations never age out merely because wall clock advances.
budgets.failed_known_costs: Retain measured attempted-work costs and release only the unused remainder after identified reconciliation evidence.
budgets.overruns: Preserve actual cost and violation flag even when it exceeds reservation; never reject the measurement or erase failure cost.
budgets.restart: Epoch totals persist indefinitely; rolling totals include all active work and terminal work completed within the last 24h. New epoch names do not reset the rolling host budget.

persistence.sqlite: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, WAL, synchronous FULL, integrity check; database corruption blocks opening and preserves bytes.
persistence.receipts: Canonical JSON, stable kind/key name, create-only atomic same-volume hard-link publication after fsync; conflicting outcomes preserve original receipt.
persistence.interrupted_receipts: Retain .partial-* files without advertising a completed result. Retry the same immutable request; publication refuses overwrite.
persistence.launch_idempotency: Repeated key must match exact request and dependency hash; duplicate reserve returns persisted state and never dispatches. OUTCOME_UNKNOWN cannot transition to RUNNING without explicit outcome reconciliation.
persistence.orphan_workers: Persist OUTCOME_UNKNOWN synthetic operations record charged at the full rolling ceiling until identified reconciliation; do not terminate unrelated processes.
persistence.outcome_reconciliation: Require create-only hashed observation receipt bound to job key/request hash, model owner/fence and observed worker identity. RUNNING requires positive known cost or conservative unknown cost plus measured process exit. Zero only from RESERVED with no worker and explicit never-dispatched/no-launch-attempt proof. Stale resolution also requires a live coordinator lease.
persistence.logical_database_integrity: Recompute request hash including dependencies and validate current state/result against durable latest event on job/budget/dependency access; corruption is preserved and blocks action. This does not attest against an attacker who can coherently rewrite both SQLite and receipt data.

testing_scope: All operations tests use temporary state and synthetic CPU process/telemetry witnesses. No native runtime, real workers or CUDA state are mocked into qualification evidence.

validation_history.reason: Windows corrupt-database constructor left an open SQLite handle; fixture cleanup exposed it. No model work.

validation_history.repair: Close failed constructor connection before propagating error.

validation_history.review_fixes: Fenced exit/no-dispatch proof refs with immutable request/lease/worker binding, live coordinator lease for stale reconciliation, non-null host witnesses, CPU completion idempotency, logical SQLite request/dependency/state/event integrity.

Bind actual cost/finished to durable outcome; reservation seconds/owner/fence/time to admission; worker identity to observation; creation time to origin. All charged rows validated; eight SQL accounting mutations fail closed.
